reply_text:
Pichai's 2022 record holds one clear dated forecast about AI and a few short-range product-launch dates from his I/O keynote.

- **Main finding:** In his Stanford Graduate School of Business talk ("View From The Top"), he said AI will transform sectors like healthcare. He added, "I think it'll still take a decade for it to fully play out." That makes it a forecast with a ten-year span. I read it in the school's own printed transcript, which is dated June 17, 2022. The talk itself was on April 22, 2022, but I got that date only from a search snippet of the event listing. I did not open that page.
- **I/O keynote, May 11, 2022:** Besides the YouTube auto-chapters goal you already have, his keynote text gives two more dated launches of AI-powered features. Immersive view in Google Maps, built with "neural rendering," was due "later this year." Auto-translated captions for Ukrainian YouTube content were due "next month." These are near-term product plans and only borderline as AI predictions, so you may decide to drop them.
- **Mirror source:** Google's own page for the keynote cut off partway through. The two launches above and the auto-chapters goal are on Google's page. I took the LaMDA and Google Chat lines from a full copy on vrarnews.com.
- **Left out:** "Coming months" for opening up LaMDA 2 and "next few months" for chat summaries in Google Chat. Both are too vague under your rules and are not about AGI timing.
- **Nothing found:** The Q3 2022 earnings call held only undated remarks such as "very early innings." Google's Google for India 2022 post was written by Sanjay Gupta, not Pichai. The CNBC TechCheck transcript from May 2022 would not open, so I quote nothing from it. I found no statement from Pichai in 2022 about when AGI arrives.
